mapping_pointer.formula: mappingFile = bank*$4000 + raw_pointer_word - $8000 (word is an absolute CPU address inside the bank)
mapping_pointer.warning: agreement of the old formula is an alignment accident; Aqua/EEZ tables in the same bank are not aligned

terrain_ring_animation.rule: return unless $D12F & 7 == 0; $D351 = ($D351 + 1) mod 4; copy 128 bytes $D399 + $D351*128 to VRAM $D39B
terrain_ring_animation.hud_note: the same routine also writes the HUD ring-icon sprite tile bytes $DBB5/$DBB7 from table $1D:$8555 (HUD, not terrain)

0x0D.meaning: breakable block $9B/$9C -> $9D + four type $07 fragments (attack posture required)

0x18.meaning: solid, no dedicated consumer found (floor handler $69B1 = RET)

0x18.follow_up: confirm visually that blocks $8A/$8B need no special rule

0x19.meaning: speed-strip surface: sets +$24 bit 0, fall request $14

0x1B.meaning: oil/sinking surface: +$24 bit 1, $D3BC += 1 every 4th $D12F update, one-way sinking projection $7010
0x1B.evidence: docs/gpz-surface19-audit.md only records the $D3BC increment; no gameplay audit of the sinking branch
0x1B.follow_up: dedicated audit: entry/exit, sink depth cap, stale +$24 bit1 on non-zero surfaces, state interactions, death/escape
